text:
zoe: FYI customer C-8421 hitting tool_call failure when calling our OpenAI-compatible API for the `geo_lookup` tool. Error coming back from our compatibility layer: "Unexpected enum value: \"Primary\" not in [\"primary\",\"secondary\"]". Raising for eng help.

sam: Can you paste the exact request they sent + the raw response we returned? Also need the request_id if you have it.

zoe: Pasting sanitized request & response below (removed auth). request_id: req_0a3f. Customer is a 3rd-party library they can't change.

zoe: ```
POST /v1/chat/completions
{
  "model": "gpt-4o-mini",
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"where is office in SF"}],
  "functions": [{"name":"geo_lookup","parameters": {"type":"object","properties": {"region":{"type":"string"},"mode":{"type":"string","enum":["primary","secondary"]}},"required":["region","mode"]}}],
  "tool_call": {
    "name": "geo_lookup",
    "arguments": "{\"region\": \"US\", \"mode\": \"Primary\"}"  // NOTE: args are stringified JSON
}
```

zoe: Raw error we returned to the customer: ```
{
  "error": "tool_call_validation_failed",
  "message": "tool 'geo_lookup' arguments failed schema validation: enum 'mode' received 'Primary' not in ['primary','secondary']",
  "request_id": "req_0a3f"
}
```

liam: Two separate compatibility problems here: (1) arguments are being passed as a string (JSON encoded) and our OA-compat normalizer only runs enum-casing normalization when args are parsed into an object. When args are stringified we treat it as opaque and skip normalization. (2) Even if we parse, we currently only lower-case enums; upstream customers sometimes send capitalized or single-letter aliases (e.g., "P" -> "primary"). We need alias mapping.

maya: Customer cannot update client (enterprise dependency). Severity S2 for them — they have live traffic. Need a server-side workaround asap.

sam: Proposed immediate mitigation: enhance oa-compat to attempt JSON.parse on `tool_call.arguments` when type looks like a stringified JSON (starts with `{` or `[`), then run enum normalization + alias mapping. Add a feature-flagged hotfix for Dedicated/Hosted. Non-breaking if parse fails.

liam: Agreed. Also flag: our routing policy uses `mode` for region preference; if normalization skips, we may route to wrong backend (causing higher latency/incorrect results). Add telemetry to capture occurrences of `tool_call_args_stringified` and `tool_call_enum_mismatch`.

sam: I'll open a small PR with tests: cases for string-encoded args, alias map (Primary,P -> primary), and ensure we don't alter other string fields. Also add a migration job to detect how many customers would be affected in the last 7 days.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary patch scheduled for 2026-03-18 03:00 UTC on hosted and dedicated canaries. Rollout controlled by feature flag `oa_compat_parse_string_args`.

sam: Assigning to @liam (eng-runtime) for the patch and @sam (eng-ml) for tests/alias map. @zoe please confirm customer consent to inspect payloads (we need full payloads for repro).

zoe: Confirmed, customer granted consent and provided a sample of 10 failing requests — I uploaded them to ticket C-8421. Link: https://redwood/support/C-8421. I also included their library version and stack trace.

liam: Will prioritize. Quick checklist: 1) attempt safe JSON.parse of `tool_call.arguments` when string-like, 2) lowercase enums + apply alias table, 3) emit telemetry event with sample hash (no PII), 4) add unit tests + e2e with a local compat harness.

sam: Note for QA: also verify that function/tool outputs (tool return payloads) don't have mis-typed fields (we saw one case where tool returned `status: \"OK\"` but our schema expects boolean `success`). If present, add tolerant coercion for tool outputs (string-to-bool) behind feature flag.

maya: Customer wants ETA and whether rollback would be required.

liam: ETA for patch + canary: ~6 hours. No rollback expected — feature-flagged and opt-in. If issues, we can flip flag off quickly.

sam: I'll track in GH issue #infra/oa-compat/482 and attach unit coverage.

zoe: Thanks — I'll update customer with workaround (use object args if possible) and ETA + canary time.

maya: Adding note: attach a short repro snippet (curl) for eng: ```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <redwood>" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"where is office"}],"functions":[{"name":"geo_lookup","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"region":{"type":"string"},"mode":{"type":"string","enum":["primary","secondary"]}}}}],"tool_call":{"name":"geo_lookup","arguments":"{\"region\":\"US\",\"mode\":\"Primary\"}"}'
```

ops-bot: incident-tracker-bot: created internal ticket INT-1219 for escalation notes.

sam: Thanks everyone. I'll post PR link when ready.

zoe: PR would be great. Customer asked to be kept in loop.

liam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/oa-compat/pull/927 (draft) — includes parse + alias map + telemetry.

zoe: Noted. Closing the loop with customer once canary goes green. :thumbsup:
